text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to wrong or harmful decisions. Fairness means treating all people equally, whatever their background. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should be transparent about how their systems work and how decisions are made. Responsible AI development means thinking about the social impact of technology before it is released. Governments, developers and users must work together to make sure AI benefits everyone and does not cause harm.
